label: Bible Study
prompt: Thou shalt not follow a _____ to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verse: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
note: Ancient Israel's law against peer pressure — the crowd doesn't get to decide what's right.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may _____ with you for ever;
verse: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
note: Jesus is leaving, but He promises another Comforter — one who will stay with them for ever.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and _____ the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verse: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
note: In KJV English 'tell' means count — God hands Abram an impossible counting assignment to show the size of the promise.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Who can understand his _____? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verse: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
note: David knows he has sins he can't even see, so he asks God to clean those out too.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the _____, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
verse: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
note: God reminded King David where he started: 'I took thee from the sheepcote' — from following sheep to ruling Israel.
